title: AFK-Analyzer
body:
# AFK Analyzer

Track your AFK (idle) time directly in-game with a clean, customizable HUD.

## Features
- **Real-time idle timer** — shows how long you've been inactive
- **Session statistics** — total AFK time and percentage of your session
- **AFK event counter** — how many times you went AFK
- **Center-screen overlay** — pulsing ★ AFK ★ alert when you go idle
- **Movable HUD** — press **H** to drag the HUD anywhere on screen

## How it works
The mod detects mouse movement and keyboard input. If you stop for 30 seconds — you're marked as AFK. The moment you move again, the timer stops and stats update.

## Installation
1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/)
2. Install [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
3. Drop `afk-analyzer.jar` into your `mods` folder

## Keybinds

1.Move Hud = H
